feedback.problem:
$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & -10 & -3 \\ -8 & -8 & 11 & 11 \\ -2 & 6 & -10 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

 

If $C=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $C$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{41}\cdot {u}_{33}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $C$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & -10 & -3 \\ -8 & -8 & 11 & 11 \\ -2 & 6 & -10 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+8{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & -10 & -3 \\ -8 & -32 & 51 & 11 \\ -2 & 6 & -10 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & -10 & -3 \\ -8 & -32 & 51 & 11 \\ -2 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & -10 & -3 \\ -8 & -4 & 11 & -1 \\ -2 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ -8 & -4 & 1 & 0 \\ -2 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & -10 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 11 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{41}=-2$ and ${u}_{33}=11,$ we get

$$
{l}_{41}\cdot {u}_{33}=(-2)\cdot 11=-22.
$$
